events.affected_behavior: Clarification answers were copied verbatim under `A(原话)`, with separate `Agent 解读` entries.
events.rationale: Directly applicable to the Gate 1 clarification log and visibly reflected in Q1–Q4.

events.affected_behavior: Clarification questions, requirements, and scope rules were kept focused and stated once.
events.rationale: Applied while authoring a relatively small configuration requirement without adding lengthy repeated guidance.

events.affected_behavior: Repository specs, configuration code, classifier code, and the originating auto-mode change were investigated before Q1.
events.rationale: This grounding established that the classifier currently inherits the Agent/run model and that no dedicated approval-model setting exists.

events.affected_behavior: No agent-role or workflow design was added.
events.rationale: The run authored a product first document, not an agent workflow, role prompt, or operating skill.

events.affected_behavior: No implementation-workflow simplification or delegation policy was specified.
events.rationale: Implementation and its workflow were outside the frozen spec phase.

events.affected_behavior: No fix loop, validation ledger, or post-review revalidation policy was defined.
events.rationale: There was no implementation or review phase.

events.affected_behavior: No prototype or frontend interaction contract was created.
events.rationale: The change concerns Gateway configuration and model routing, not frontend work.

events.affected_behavior: No Web IM visual or interaction styling decisions were made.
events.rationale: The brief did not introduce or alter a content-centric UI surface.

events.affected_behavior: No technical design structure or visualization was produced.
events.rationale: The envelope stopped at Gate 1 and prohibited design work.

events.affected_behavior: No architecture or design review was performed.
events.rationale: Reviewers and design review were expressly out of scope.

events.affected_behavior: The spec did not prescribe a shared implementation owner or cross-product regression mechanism.
events.rationale: Implementation ownership belongs to design, and Owner evidence established that Coding CLI must remain outside the product scope.

events.affected_behavior: No bugfix RCA or originating-feature repair analysis was undertaken.
events.rationale: The request was classified as a new feature, not a bugfix.

events.affected_behavior: No runtime reproduction or live acceptance was conducted.
events.rationale: The task ended at the specification gate before implementation or acceptance.

events.affected_behavior: Acceptance scenarios stayed at operator- or user-observable behavior and avoided field names, APIs, modules, and internal topology.
events.rationale: The spec describes configured model selection, startup failure, approval behavior, and observable model-service request records while deferring implementation details.

events.affected_behavior: No canonical-spec merge, architecture update, or archival lifecycle was specified.
events.rationale: This was an active first document, not change completion.

events.affected_behavior: No retrospective timeline or incident analysis was produced.
events.rationale: The task was neither an incident nor a retrospective.

events.affected_behavior: No new repository governance rule or enforcement mechanism was introduced.
events.rationale: The structural self-check validated the document but did not add contract enforcement.

events.affected_behavior: Omitting the new PA setting preserves the existing Agent/run-model behavior instead of requiring one canonical configured model.
events.rationale: The Owner explicitly rejected fallback to the PA default and required backward-compatible omission semantics; that task-specific decision outweighed the general preference against compatibility fallbacks. Its clear-failure principle still aligned with the separate invalid-explicit-model decision, but that behavior was grounded by Owner answer O03.

events.affected_behavior: Scope was restricted to Personal Assistant and only the automatic tool-approval classifier; Coding CLI, normal run generation, deterministic safety rules, and human approval were explicit non-goals.
events.rationale: This directly prevented unrelated cross-product and permission-system expansion.

events.affected_behavior: No autonomous implementation or validation loop was specified.
events.rationale: Implementation was prohibited by the task envelope.

events.affected_behavior: No external reference implementation was consulted or adapted.
events.rationale: The brief named no reference, and network or outside-workspace access was prohibited.

events.affected_behavior: No run timeout or watchdog behavior was changed.
events.rationale: The feature concerns approval-classifier model selection only.

events.affected_behavior: No active-run steering semantics were specified.
events.rationale: Steering and multi-client message injection were unrelated to the brief.

events.affected_behavior: No end-to-end test catalog or test strategy was defined.
events.rationale: Test design belongs to later phases and was outside Gate 1.
